questions.stem: Dr. Priya is conducting a talk on the screening of cervical cancer with a Pap smear. She works in a clinic in a low-resource setting, and she was planning to screen a woman in her 20s. Which of the following is true regarding cervical cancer screening guidelines in her workplace?

options.label: A
options.text: Co-testing (pap and Hr HPV) every 5 years starting at 25 years

options.label: B
options.text: Pap smear every 3 years, starting at 21 years

options.label: C
options.text: Hr HPV testing every 5 years starting at 30 years

options.label: D
options.text: Pap smear every 5 years starting at 21 years
